items.title: Vercel Flags starts 7x faster and no longer extends function duration
items.summary: On Vercel, the  SDK now initializes faster on cold starts, and usage reporting no longer keeps functions running after the response.Vercel FlagsTwo changes speed up SDK initialization on cold starts:In internal testing, eliminating the network wait reduced p75 cold-start SDK initialization time from over 70 ms to 10 ms, roughly 7x faster.After initialization, flag reads are effectively instant. Across cold and warm invocations, p99 flag-read latency is under 1 ms.The SDK previously used  for usage reporting, keeping functions running after the response was sent. It now passes usage events to the Vercel runtime, so reporting no longer adds to function duration.waitUntilUpdate  to version 1.5.3 or later and redeploy your application:@flags-sdk/vercelLearn more in the .Flags SDK documentationRead moreFaster cold startsUsage reporting no longer extends function durationThe SDK loads and parses the flags datafile bundled with your deployment as soon as the client is created, so it’s ready before your code evaluates its first flag.Every function invocation now includes the current datafile revision, so the SDK can check whether the bundled datafile is up to date without a network request.

items.title: Control AI crawlers and assistants separately in Vercel Firewall
items.summary: You can now log or block requests from AI crawlers and AI assistants separately with the AI Bots managed ruleset in .Vercel FirewallFor example, you can block AI crawlers while allowing AI assistants to retrieve your content to answer users’ questions. Vercel updates the rules as new bots are added.To configure these controls, open your project’s . Under , enable  and select the gear icon beside it. Set an action for AI crawlers and AI assistants, then review and publish your changes.Security > Firewall > RulesBot ManagementAI BotsYou can also modify these rule settings using the Vercel CLI:type: embedded-entry-inline id: 30azXU4HVTfrsO9MbBOCLvReview the changes with , then apply them with .vercel firewall diffvercel firewall publishThe AI Bots managed ruleset is available on all plans.
